mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, name, template_type, first_weight, first_fee, additional_weight, additional_fee, is_default, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM express_fee_template WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC

SELECT id, company_id, name, template_type, first_weight, first_fee, additional_weight, additional_fee, is_default, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM express_fee_template WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY is_default DESC, id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.company_id, t.name, t.template_type, t.first_weight, t.first_fee, t.additional_weight, t.additional_fee, t.is_default, t.status, t.remark, t.created_at, t.updated_at, c.name AS company_name FROM express_fee_template t LEFT JOIN express_company c ON t.company_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND t.company_id = #{companyId}
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.is_default DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT id, company_id, name, template_type, first_weight, first_fee, additional_weight, additional_fee, is_default, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM express_fee_template WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, company_id, name, template_type, first_weight, first_fee, additional_weight, additional_fee, is_default, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM express_fee_template WHERE is_default = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO express_fee_template (company_id, name, template_type, first_weight, first_fee, additional_weight, additional_fee, is_default, status, remark) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{name}, #{templateType}, #{firstWeight}, #{firstFee}, #{additionalWeight}, #{additionalFee}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE express_fee_template
company_id = #{companyId}, name = #{name}, template_type = #{templateType}, first_weight = #{firstWeight}, first_fee = #{firstFee}, additional_weight = #{additionalWeight}, additional_fee = #{additionalFee}, is_default = #{isDefault}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE express_fee_template SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE express_fee_template SET is_default = 0 WHERE is_default = 1 AND deleted = 0
